subject: Original-client S5 Conrad usable approach and checkpointed use
setup: Isolated copied Game/world/character DB and Wine prefix in a bubblewrap network namespace. Compatibility client 1.16.5.0; normal hostiles. No live Docker/DIT files or services were changed. The source character had mission 1995 objective 2 completed and objective 3 active. Only read-only .where was used during ordinary movement.

observations.uncertainty: Client .where display precision ~0.01 m; held-key durations are wall clock and collision/FPS make endpoint variable.
observations.finding: From the copied soldier checkpoint (-102.39453,86.890625,73.4375), ordinary key holds S 1000 ms, A 1000 ms, A 650 ms and W 850 ms reached about (-94.695,85.031,66.063) around the east side of the local obstacle. The client displayed Salvagable Materials and Press [Mouse Button 2] to use. This is the seeded analogue class 21961 at inferred (-98.0,85.39,67.2), not an original recovered corpse model.

A second ordinary movement run (S 1000 ms, A 1650 ms, W 850 ms) reached (-94.73047,84.99609,65.640625). The same usable prompt appeared. W+D 450 ms from there left the player at exactly the same displayed coordinate, indicating a local collision stop; entering the seeded object coordinate is unnecessary for interaction.

observations.source_location: run 09 step1-hover.png, step2-after-rightclick.png and game.log line 123; run-s5-corpse-agent-09-20260924.py
observations.finding: The copied character DB login coordinate was explicitly edited to the ordinary-reached run 04 coordinate, then the original client rendered the usable prompt. Right-click at screen pixel (740,386) sent RequestUseObject. The client showed Objective Completed / Remove the bomb from Conrad’s corpse; the tracker switched to Destroy the crashed dropship before the bomb timer expires and displayed 00:09:59.

Copied character DB persisted mission 1995 objective 3 status 2, objective 2 status 2, objective 1 status 1 with timer_anchor_ms=1790227161182 and timer_remaining_ms=600000. The objective-1 record carries the mission timer even while the visible tracker shows the wreck objective.

observations.uncertainty: Held-key wall-clock timings vary with collision and client frame rate.
observations.finding: A single-run replay of the run-03 movement and click reached (-95.957,84.77,63.01), missed the usable prompt, and objective 3 remained active. Therefore no same-run soldier-to-corpse-use result is claimed.

observations.source_location: adv_bootcamp-entities-joined.csv indices 18, 746, 1207, 1208, 1262; client map decoded from 1.16.5.0
observations.finding: The original trench bunker (index 18) has broad bounds x[-125.43,-82.57], z[48.58,91.44]; sandbag index 1262 bounds x[-100.74,-96.41], z[68.01,69.76]; sandbag index 746 bounds x[-104.42,-100.13], z[67.87,69.48]; Forean corpse indices 1207 and 1208 occupy x[-98.75,-96.45], z[69.53,71.75] and x[-100.94,-98.94], z[70.06,72.49]. Their local collision and the bunker geometry explain why direct line input stopped. Bounds are broad mesh bounds, not exact collision hulls.

assessment: Ordinary original-client movement can reach the interaction prompt, and checkpointed use of that reached floor coordinate completes objective 3 and starts the 600-second timer. Current inferred seeded coordinate is usable; no reposition is warranted by this evidence. The analogue appearance remains a fidelity gap. The exact final-live corpse position, model, and same-run soldier-to-use path remain unverified.
next_verification: Repeat the soldier-to-corpse route and use in one continuous run, then reach and destroy the crashed dropship through ordinary movement while the timer remains active.
